## What happened

A clear description of the problem.

## Which tool

The name of the tool, and the address of the page you were on.

## The file you gave it

Do not attach a file that holds private information.
The tools run on your own device, so nobody here has seen your file.
If the problem needs a file to reproduce, make a small one that shows it.

- Format and extension:
- Size:
- Anything unusual about it (very large, transparent, animated, many pages):

## What you expected

What you expected to get back.

## What actually happened

The actual result, the error message, or the description of the wrong output.
Copy any error text exactly.

## Your browser

- Browser and version:
- Operating system:
- Phone or computer:

## The developer console

Open the developer tools, reload the page, run the tool again, and copy
anything red from the Console tab.
Most problems in this project come from a worker or a WebAssembly module, and
the console is the only place that says so.
